blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Education Secretary Sonny Angara welcomed on Monday the Department of Budget and Management’s approval of the creation of 3,627 teaching and teaching-related positions for the newly established Schools Division Office (SDO) of Sulu. — a major development for public school teachers and personnel across Sulu, “We know that there’s some worry about such a big change in the work situation. So our message to our teachers and workers in Sulu: You are part of the DepEd family, you are protected, and we won’t neglect your livelihood,” Angara said in Filipino in a statement issued on Tuesday. “It’s our […]...
